class.name: PuertsEnvironment
class.brief_description: Runs scripts and exchanges values with a selected script engine.
class.description: Create a runtime with [method initialize], execute code with [method eval], and exchange values with [method set_global] and [method get_global]. [b]Lifetime:[/b] Keep a reference to the environment while using its script values or script-backed [Callable]s. Use the environment, its values, and its [PuertsStringNameUtf8Cache] on the same thread. [b]Errors:[/b] Register [method set_error_callback] before initialization to receive errors, including script exceptions and unsupported backend operations. [codeblocks] [gdscript] var environment := PuertsEnvironment.new() environment.set_error_callback(func(message: String): push_error(message)) if environment.initialize(PuertsV8Backend.new(), PuertsStringNameUtf8Cache.new()) == OK: environment.set_global(&"answer", 42) var result := environment.eval("answer + 1", &"example.js") if result != null: print(result.to_native()) # 43 environment.dispose() [/gdscript] [/codeblocks] [b]Web:[/b] [PuertsWebBackend] allows only one environment, which remains alive until page unload. [method dispose] and reinitialization are unsupported.

method.name: initialize
method.description: Creates a runtime using [param backend] and a non-null [param string_name_utf8_cache]. The environment retains both resources on success. Reinitialization disposes the previous idle runtime and invalidates its values and callables. If creating the replacement fails, the environment remains uninitialized. Returns [constant @GlobalScope.OK] on success, [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] for invalid arguments, [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNCONFIGURED] for an invalid backend interface, or [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_CANT_CREATE] if runtime creation fails. Returns [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_BUSY] during initialization, disposal, or an active script operation. For [PuertsWebBackend], reinitialization returns [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_ALREADY_IN_USE]; creating a second environment returns [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_CANT_CREATE].

method.name: dispose
method.description: Releases the runtime and permanently invalidates its script values and script-backed [Callable]s. Safe to repeat; the environment can subsequently be initialized again. When called during a script operation or callback, stops accepting new operations and defers destruction until the outermost operation returns. [PuertsWebBackend] reports an error and keeps the environment running.

method.name: is_ready
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the environment is initialized and accepts script operations.

method.name: get_backend
method.description: Returns the current backend resource, or [code]null[/code] when no backend is attached.

method.name: set_error_callback
method.description: Sets [param callback] to receive initialization errors, script exceptions, rejected operations, and script [code]log_error[/code] messages. The callback receives one [String] argument and runs synchronously on the calling thread. Set it before [method initialize] to receive initialization errors. Pass [code]Callable()[/code] to disable it. Messages are discarded when no valid callback is set.

method.name: set_warn_callback
method.description: Sets [param callback] to receive one [String] argument for messages sent through the script global [code]log_warn[/code]. It runs synchronously on the calling thread. Pass [code]Callable()[/code] to disable it; messages without a valid callback are discarded.

method.name: set_info_callback
method.description: Sets [param callback] to receive one [String] argument for messages sent through the script global [code]log_info[/code]. It runs synchronously on the calling thread. Pass [code]Callable()[/code] to disable it; messages without a valid callback are discarded.

method.name: eval
method.description: Executes [param code] and returns its result as a [PuertsScriptValue]. [param chunk_name] identifies the source in diagnostics. Returns [code]null[/code] on failure or when the environment is not ready. Successful script null and undefined results are wrapped; inspect them with [method PuertsScriptValue.is_null] and [method PuertsScriptValue.is_undefined]. For Lua, use [code]return[/code] to produce a result, for example [code]return 40 + 2[/code].

method.name: set_global
method.description: Converts [param value] to a script value and assigns it to global [param name]. A [PuertsScriptValue] must be valid and belong to this environment.

method.name: get_global
method.description: Reads global [param name] as a [PuertsScriptValue]. Missing globals follow the backend language rules, such as JavaScript undefined or Lua nil. Returns [code]null[/code] on failure or when the environment is not ready.

method.name: tick
method.description: Runs one backend update step. Supported by [PuertsV8Backend] and [PuertsNodejsBackend]; call regularly, for example from [method Node._process].

method.name: open_debugger
method.description: Starts the inspector on [param port] for [PuertsV8Backend] or [PuertsNodejsBackend]. Use [method debugger_tick] to process inspector traffic and [method close_debugger] when finished.

method.name: debugger_tick
method.description: Processes one inspector update for [PuertsV8Backend] or [PuertsNodejsBackend] and returns the backend inspector status. Returns [code]false[/code] if the environment is not ready or the backend does not support inspection; these failures are reported through [method set_error_callback].

method.name: terminate_execution
method.description: Requests termination of script execution in [PuertsV8Backend] or [PuertsNodejsBackend].
